answer: Geofencing attestation gates entry: every identity proves a unique physical cell by returning signed probes from three anchors within 200 meters, and no two identities may share a cell. A farm spinning 1000 clones must field 1000 distinct devices in 1000 separate cells, renting hardware at roughly 50 dollars each. No bulk shortcut: one antenna cannot emit 1000 distinct radio fingerprints, and probes expire every 60 seconds so offline replay fails. Detected clusters forfeit bonds and face 12-epoch exclusion. Like an island spiraling into a wharf, only distinct places earn passage.
